disclaimer: Experimental out-of-sample validated Poisson expected-goals models. Not betting advice.

runtimePolicy.distribution: independent Poisson scoreline matrix with Dixon-Coles low-score adjustment (rho=-0.05)
runtimePolicy.reason: Home/away goals are modelled as Poisson counts; all markets derive from the same scoreline matrix so probabilities stay mutually consistent. The Dixon-Coles low-score adjustment (rho) ships only when it improves validation 1X2 logLoss beyond the 0.0005 deadband.
runtimePolicy.totalsCalibration: Isotonic match-totals calibrators are embedded only when their cross-fitted within-validation logLoss gain clears the 0.0005 deadband.
